settings.headline: Prepared With Care, Sent With Intention
settings.subcopy: The Delivery Concierge explains preparation, packaging, shipping timelines, tracking, and what to expect before your Melato piece reaches you.

settings.packaging_text: Every order is packed to protect the piece first. The packaging is clean, intentional, and made to keep the garment presentable from dispatch to first wear.
settings.checklist:
Confirm your size.
Review your delivery destination.
Check order timing.
Read care notes.
Contact Customer Care for urgent or uncertain orders.
